waypoints.name: Rock of Ages Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Telluride, drive west on Highway 145 about 6 miles and turn left onto the dirt Silver Pick Road. After 4 miles turn right onto FS 622 for 2.3 miles, then turn right at the Rock of Ages sign onto FS 645 and drive 2.2 miles to the trailhead. About 1 mile up FS 645 the road fords Big Bear Creek, which is usually manageable by mid-July.

waypoints.name: Wilson Peak
waypoints.directions: Follow the Wilson Mesa Trail about half a mile to the Rock of Ages Trail and climb out of Elk Creek Basin into Silver Pick Basin on old mining roads, staying on the trail across private land, then switchback up talus to the Rock of Ages saddle. Cross the loose slope east to the Wilson Peak-Gladstone saddle, traverse south-side ledges onto the southwest ridge, follow it to the false summit, downclimb into the notch and make the exposed final moves to the summit.
